run_adsorbml_pipeline: run the AdsorbML pipeline for a given slab and adsorbate using a pretrained ML model
generate_adsorbate_slab_configs: generate multiple adsorbate-slab configurations from a slab structure and list of adsorbates
relax_atoms_structure: relax an atomic structure using an ASE optimizer and return energy and forces
reference_adsorption_energies: reference adsorbate-slab energies to atomic and slab energies using gas phase reference values
detect_adsorbate_anomalies: detect anomalies like dissociation, desorption, surface changes, or intercalation between initial and final structures
